Nadia, Gideon landed on 280 seats for Vantorre Group. I posted that as a reply to your message in #strategic-pod.

His July 1 update first said 300. About five minutes later he corrected it to 280 active production seats as of that day, because the 300 included sandbox logins from their May rollout. Ruth confirmed 280 in the same thread.

280 is the July 1 number, so check it against the current roster if you need today's count.
